scope: Selected DESI EDR VI/FastSpecFit deep-field galaxies, 0.1 < z_VI < 0.4 and Milky-Way-dereddened total BASS-r AB < 20.5; original 891 test galaxies plus 441 new test galaxies.
success: Returned finite Redrock redshift, ZWARN=0, DELTACHI2>40, abs(z_fit-z_VI)/(1+z_VI)<0.0033; all selected targets including missing fits stay in the denominator.
primary_threshold: first sampled time at which the one-sided 95% Clopper-Pearson lower bound, Bonferroni-corrected over five exposure times within each group and sky, is at least 95%
secondary_thresholds: point estimate and unadjusted one-sided 95% lower bound, each first sampled time at or above 95%; also calculate 90% for consistency with prior study
magnitude_groups: r<=19, 19<r<=20, 20<r<20.5; new faint and all are both reported
spectral_groups: original frozen bpt_star_forming, weak_line_old, and other_unclassified labels; plus all magnitude-redshift-spectral intersections
observable_groups: intersect each magnitude group with old calibration-set median splits in dereddened total g-r and Legacy Survey fiber-r; exploratory, no joint adjustment for all reported groups
fiber_r_definition: 22.5-2.5*log10(FIBERFLUX_R/MW_TRANSMISSION_R), AB, Legacy Survey DESI aperture; valid positive flux and transmission only
small_group_status: A group with fewer than ceil(log(0.01)/log(target)) galaxies cannot meet the five-time-adjusted threshold even if all targets succeed.
caveats: Conditional binomial approximation, single selected field, shared reference observations and model selection; bounds omit sky, atmospheric, instrument, and population systematics. Each time has an independently seeded noise realization. An 8-object pilot had already been inspected before this analysis design; original grouping choices transfer from the previous frozen study and must not be described as fully blind for this extension.
